predecessor.outcome: TP-HDC-01 lacks efficiency advantage vs 24-byte exact counters

question: At identical real 128/512/2048 byte persistent memory caps and with task IDs known to every arm, does int8 task-projected hyperdimensional superposition retain older stochastic action-outcome predictions better than exact packed or hashed packed memories after 2x distinct task exposure?
hypothesis: TP-HDC may reduce task interference in overcapacity conditions, but can be falsified by packed exact and hashed counter controls; no non-native benefit should be presumed.

frozen_design.timeline: A tasks [0,N) trained once, score expected A-law Brier; then B tasks [N,2N) trained once, score expected A-law Brier again, without A retraining or prediction-update leakage.
frozen_design.task_laws: For each (seed,task,context,action), SHA256('TP-HDC-02|law|v1|'+seed+'/'+task+'/'+context+'/'+action) first byte low bit => Bernoulli p=0.2 when zero, 0.8 when one. Same law available to evaluation only, never candidate forecasts.
frozen_design.observations: Four training samples for each task, each c in [0,1], a in [0,1], in that order. Sample y by random.Random(seed) for each case, task order ascending A then B. All models receive precisely the same sample. Task ID given to all arms.
frozen_design.key_generation: Deterministic seed from SHA256('TP-HDC-02|key|v1|'+task+'/'+context+'/'+action+'/'+outcome) first 8 bytes interpreted little-endian, numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(seed)).integers(0,2,size=budget,dtype=int8)*2-1. Cache keys for only the current task; count the 8*budget transient projection bytes.
frozen_design.hdc: Persistent signed-int8 vector of length budget, initialized zero, one vector update per observed outcome, saturate [-128,127]. Decoder max(0,dot(v,key)/budget) with Beta(1,1)-style +1 per outcome.
frozen_design.exact_controls: Exact bounded LRU and exact deterministic-priority-reservoir: per task, 2-byte task+1 ID plus eight 3-bit saturating outcome counts (3 bytes), so five persistent bytes/task. No hidden sidecar metadata. Capacity=floor(budget/5), eviction included. Unbounded exact separately labeled unattainable reference.
frozen_design.hashed_control: Deterministic task-keyed hash modulo floor(budget/3) buckets, each bucket eight packed 3-bit count slots (3 bytes); no hidden per-task learned state, saturation at seven. Hash function SHA256('TP-HDC-02|bucket|v1|'+task) first eight bytes little endian.
frozen_design.checkpoints: For every arm, budget-byte payload + four-byte experiment tag + 32-byte SHA256. Cold restores reproduce forecasts and corrupted payload must reject. Exact entries include task IDs; LRU ordering must be retained. Only learned/checkpoint bytes are bounded; runtime allocation, regenerated projection keys, peak RSS and cost separately reported.
frozen_design.primary_execution_budget: One frozen local CPU primary run with five cases x four seeds x five bounded arms plus oracle reference; no extra seeds, retuning or score-driven changes. Independent reimplementations can replay same source law/data, but no first-use.
frozen_design.expected_brier: Average p*(1-q)^2+(1-p)*q^2 over all old task/context/action cells. Measure pre-B and post-B; lower better. Mean and per-seed metrics preserved; difference post-pre measures forgetting.
frozen_design.compute: Report wall time by arm, HDC key-cache peak and saturation count, exact capacity and stored count, actual persistent bytes, checkpoint size and peak RSS. Use original seed/case 4x4 training samples for all.
frozen_design.invalidity: Any future-outcome access, mismatched observations, hidden unbounded learned memory, non-deterministic keys, broken snapshot restore, corruption accepted, used source not matching prereg commit, or comparison that omits strong controls invalidates primary.
frozen_design.result_rules: SOURCE_FREE_SCREEN_POSITIVE only if HDC post-B expected Brier <= best of LRU, priority and hashed by >=0.005 in mean AND >=3 of 4 seeds in at least one overcapacity case, HDC A drift <=0.02 for all four seeds of that same case, and its measured peak resident memory <= best-control peak *2; otherwise SCREEN_NEGATIVE_OR_MIXED. No result qualifies SCIENTIFIC_PASS without native replication and preauthorized first-use.
